Adam Arous.note: Arous is back-line insurance for Tunisia. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Adam Arous.noteZh: 他给Tunisia那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Ali Abdi.summary: Ali Abdi is a Tunisia left-back at Nice who gives the national team overlap timing, crossing quality, and wide defending.
Ali Abdi.note: Abdi is in the quiet-work part of Tunisia's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Ali Abdi.noteZh: 他是Tunisia主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Amine Ben Hmida.summary: Mohamed Amine Ben Hamida is a Tunisia left-back at Espérance de Tunis who gives the national team defensive width, left-footed balance, and tournament experience.
Amine Ben Hmida.note: Hamida gives Tunisia defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Amine Ben Hmida.noteZh: 他是Tunisia在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Anis Slimane.summary: Anis Ben Slimane is a Tunisia attacking midfielder at Norwich City who gives the national team carrying power, between-lines receiving, and midfield height.
Anis Slimane.note: Slimane has been one of Tunisia's midfield connectors in this tournament. He keeps the next pass alive and helps the team avoid rushed choices.
Anis Slimane.noteZh: 他是Tunisia让控球不散掉的球员之一。看点是他多早就知道下一脚传给谁。

Aymen Dahmen.note: Dahmen sits behind the starter for Tunisia, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Aymen Dahmen.noteZh: 他给Tunisia保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Dylan Bronn.note: Bronn is the kind of defender Tunisia can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Dylan Bronn.noteZh: 他是Tunisia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Elias Achouri.note: Achouri gives Tunisia midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Elias Achouri.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Tunisia来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Elias Saad.note: Saad gives Tunisia a route when possession needs to become pressure. He is there to make a defender choose.
Elias Saad.noteZh: 他是Tunisia这届赛事中被重点使用的进攻路线之一。他先让第一名防守者移动，再让终结或最后一传出现。

Ellyes Skhiri.note: Skhiri is a tempo player for Tunisia. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Ellyes Skhiri.noteZh: 他让Tunisia在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Firas Chaouat.note: Chaouat gives Tunisia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Firas Chaouat.noteZh: 他是Tunisia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Hannibal Mejbri.note: Mejbri has already made goals for Tunisia against Sweden and Netherlands. Watch the pass before the chance looks obvious.
Hannibal Mejbri.noteZh: 他这届赛事的价值在于供给Tunisia的进攻。他能在防线移动还没完成时看见跑动。

Hazem Mastouri.note: Mastouri has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Netherlands. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Hazem Mastouri.noteZh: 他已经为Tunisia进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Ismael Gharbi.note: Gharbi is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Tunisia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Ismael Gharbi.noteZh: 他给Tunisia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Khalil Ayari.note: Ayari is the forward Tunisia can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Khalil Ayari.noteZh: 他给Tunisia替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.note: Mahmoud gives Tunisia a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.noteZh: 他是Tunisia的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Montassar Talbi.note: Talbi has been part of Tunisia's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Montassar Talbi.noteZh: 他给Tunisia后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Mortadha Ben Ouanes.note: Ouanes gives Tunisia cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.noteZh: 他是Tunisia后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mouhib Chamakh.summary: Abdelmouhib Chamakh is a Tunisia goalkeeper at Club Africain who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, height, and domestic title-winning rhythm.
Mouhib Chamakh.note: Chamakh is goalkeeper cover for Tunisia. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Mouhib Chamakh.noteZh: 他是Tunisia门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Moutaz Neffati.note: Neffati is the kind of defender Tunisia can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Moutaz Neffati.noteZh: 他是Tunisia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Omar Rekik.note: Rekik has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Sweden. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Omar Rekik.noteZh: 他已经为Tunisia进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Raed Chikhaoui.summary: Raed Chikhaoui is a Tunisia centre-back at US Monastir who gives the national team size, aerial defending, and fresh back-line depth.
Raed Chikhaoui.note: Chikhaoui is the kind of defender Tunisia can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Raed Chikhaoui.noteZh: 他是Tunisia艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Rani Khedira.note: Khedira is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Tunisia, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Rani Khedira.noteZh: 他给Tunisia提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Rayan Elloumi.note: Elloumi gives Tunisia a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Rayan Elloumi.noteZh: 他是Tunisia在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Sabri Ben Hessen.note: Hessen is Tunisia's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Sabri Ben Hessen.noteZh: 他是Tunisia的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Sebastian Tounekti.note: Tounekti is the forward Tunisia can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Sebastian Tounekti.noteZh: 他给Tunisia替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Yan Valery.note: Valery gives Tunisia one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Yan Valery.noteZh: 他是Tunisia无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。
